meta.market_name: KEMBER INTERIORS (New Zealand-facing); 'Kember Kreative Interiors' is not used unless a legal or licensing requirement demands it
meta.title: Kember Interiors design tokens

provenance_key.A: EXACT KEMBER — directly verified from official Kember material
provenance_key.B: EXISTING KEMBER — observed in current Kember communications
provenance_key.C: TRANSFERRED FROM FREVINI — a Frevini rule intentionally adopted
provenance_key.D: KEMBER ADAPTATION — a new or modified rule to make the Frevini system work for Kember

meta.note: kemberfloors.com and its PDFs were not reachable from the authoring environment; Kember facts come from the supplied captures and from the site and its catalogues as indexed by search. Colours labelled B are pixel-measured from the captures. The wordmark SVG is a reconstruction; the official master governs.

revisions.change: Initial system, derived from Frevini v1.1

inherits.note: Values are repeated below where a consumer needs a single self-contained file.

tiers.core: Every document uses all three. Umber is the only colour that carries text.
tiers.utility: Tables, charts, icons and diagrams only. Never a page field, never body text.

kember-umber.role: The brand colour. All text, headings, rules, fields, logo. Measured from the deep oak section fields on kemberfloors.com; adopted as primary after testing against the existing blue, navy and a neutral charcoal.
kember-umber.pantone_reference: To be matched from a printed swatch

oak-white.role: Secondary page field: editorial covers, alternating sections, callouts, icon fields. Slightly cooler than Frevini Warm White so the two brands' fields differ.

white.role: Default page field; reversed type and logo.

kember-slate.role: Icons on Oak White, badges, second chart series. Derived from the existing wordmark grey, darkened to 3.3 : 1 on white for graphics. Never text below 18 pt.

umber-60.role: Secondary text at 14 pt+, chart axes, de-emphasised metadata.

umber-8.role: Alternate table-row fill on white pages.

oak.description: American oak neutrals sampled from Kember floors in the captures. Chart series, section-device and diagram fills only. Names are generic so they are never confused with Kember product colour names.

black.role: Photographic overlay under white type. Replaces the brown-tinted overlays on the current site.

kember-blue.status: Not used in New Zealand material. Fails text contrast (3.5 : 1 on white) and reads as technology rather than timber. Permitted only as the link colour on kemberfloors.com until that site is updated.

wordmark-grey.status: Not used for the mark (2.1 : 1 on white). Survives only as the source of Kember Slate.

contrast.note: WCAG AA: 4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text and graphics. Slate is graphics and large text only.

weights_restricted.700: not part of the standard hierarchy

availability-label.border: 0.5 pt umber (available) or umber-20 with umber-60 text (capability)

rules.bold: Not part of the standard brand hierarchy. Use Medium (500) for emphasis. SemiBold (600) only for key numbers at 24 pt and above.
rules.units: Metric first; imperial in brackets on first mention in technical documents (D).
rules.measure_body: 55–75 characters; never more than 8 of 12 columns on A4

application.open_field: About 40 percent in editorial, presentation and marketing layouts. Technical pages may be denser within the same margins, spacing scale and grouping.

logo_slides.position: top-left at safe margin on title and closing slides only

poster.hero_image: at least 55 percent of the page area

one_pager.columns: 2 or 3 equal columns beneath the hero
one_pager.cta: single text CTA with rule, bottom-left

line.boxes_and_borders: not used; the only bordered elements are the availability labels

radius.note: Square corners. The rounded image cards and circular buttons on the current site are not used.

section_device.description: Kember's one specific graphic device: the three-layer engineered section. An information device, not decoration.
section_device.core_grain: drawn perpendicular to the faces, umber-20 to oak-mid hairlines at 0.5 pt
section_device.labels: technical style, right of the section, one per layer
never: in colours outside umber and the oak neutrals
section_device.file: drawn inline as SVG; reference in src/kember-guidelines.html

logo.status: Wordmark reconstructed from kemberfloors.com captures at measured proportions (unicase letterforms, uniform stroke ≈ 10 % of height). Reference only; the official master governs.
logo.clear_space: half the wordmark height on all sides
logo.position: top-left at the margin; bottom-left on posters

categories.architecture: finished spaces where the oak floor, wall or ceiling is the subject
categories.material: American oak grain, texture, board edges, sawn character
categories.engineering: three-layer construction, cross-grain core, profiles, components
categories.making: factory, manufacturing, finishing, where high-quality assets exist
categories.application: floor, wall, ceiling, doors and other interior applications, one per image

imagery.text_on_image: white only, over a darkened or naturally deep region
imagery.crop: square corners; full bleed or column edges; level horizontals
imagery.tone: natural light, warm-neutral white balance, restrained saturation, no blue grading, no HDR, no filters
imagery.status: Current assets are captures of kemberfloors.com; a photography commission in the five categories is required before production collateral.

categories.name: Flooring
products: E3plank engineered flooring, American Northern Oak, curated colour selection

categories.name: Wall + Ceiling
products: American oak lining; New Zealand specification to be confirmed

labels.rule: Capability is never presented as stock. New categories are added as rows under the brand, not as a new brand.

document_formats.technical_data_disclaimer: Product information shown in this guide demonstrates information hierarchy and layout. Current technical data must always be sourced from the applicable Kember technical documentation.
